claim: Local baseline only. No speedup is claimed.

methodology.cacheCondition: New browser context per sample. Vite preview responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Repeat SPA navigation reuses code in the active page runtime and is not a warm HTTP cache sample.
methodology.networkProfile: Unthrottled local loopback preview and API. No field network cohort is defined.
methodology.eventTiming: Raw PerformanceEventTiming entries at a 16 ms threshold. These values are not INP.
